parameters.query:
SELECT
  EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.students WHERE id = $1::uuid AND teacher_id = $2::uuid) AS student_owned,
(SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM teachers_manager.schedules
    WHERE teacher_id = $2::uuid AND day_of_week = $3::integer
    AND (start_time, start_time + ($4::integer || ' minutes')::interval)
        OVERLAPS ($5::time, $5::time + ($4::integer || ' minutes')::interval)
    AND ($6 = '' OR id::text <> $6)
  ) AS conflict_count;
